text:
mira: FYI - OrchidLabs onboarding health shows repeated tail latency on /v1/respond. Renewal in 11 days. Need an evidence bundle + provisional credit calc.
otto: paste the contract SLOs and numbers pls (p50/p95/p99 + uptime)
mira: SLA: 99.95% uptime; SLO: 95% requests < 150ms for /v1/respond. Last 7d: uptime 99.96%, p50=60ms, p95=260ms, p99=620ms. p95 breached >150ms on 3 days (2 business days).
felix: contract has credit trigger when p95>150ms on >1 business day in a rolling 7d. We'll need timeseries csv, top traces, autoscale/cache events, and token/request counts for breach windows.
jen: legal: remember "provisional" language. Credits held pending audit of metrics/traces in annex. Also require explicit placeholders for token counts and exact breach windows.
slo-bot: automated: 2025-12-07T04:12Z - p95 exceeded 150ms on 3 days this rolling-7d. Incident ticket CS-2786 opened: https://redwood.internal/incidents/CS-2786
mira: ops ask: can we try quick mitigations (prefix cache canary + one prewarmed replica) and ask Orchid for a 20min synthetic during canary? If warmup lowers tails within 48h we can reduce provisional credit.
otto: low-risk. I'll schedule canary toggle at 02:00 UTC and monitor 6h post-toggle. Command I'll run for traces:
```
redwood traces query --route "/v1/respond" --filter "latency>200" --since 7d --limit 20
redwood metrics export --service inference --route "/v1/respond" --since 7d --by day --agg p50,p95,p99,requests,uptime > orchid-metrics.csv
```
felix: I'll compute provisional credit scenarios: (A) no remediation, (B) remediation reduces breach days -> adjusted credit. Formula draft = (breach_days/7) * monthly_commitment * credit_rate. Need requests and avg tokens in breach windows.
jen: legal will prepare provisional wording and audit checklist. include links to CSV + trace IDs in annex.
orchid-contact: we can run the synthetic at 02:30 UTC during your canary. happy to help.
mira: excellent. Action items: otto (canary + traces), felix (credit calc + spreadsheets), jen (legal wording), orchid-contact (synthetic run). Deadline: assemble bundle in 36h for CSM and legal review.
otto: will attach top 10 traces and autoscale timeline to CS-2786 after the 6h snapshot.
felix: uploading a provisional calc template with two scenarios and placeholders for tokens. will link to internal draft once done.
mira: comms plan: 1) 1-page plain-language summary of findings, 2) proposed mitigations and timeline, 3) provisional credit estimate + calc worksheet, 4) appendix (metrics CSV, traces, infra logs). We'll present provisional credit but note it's subject to final verification.
jen: agreed. Legal note: avoid language that implies withholding credits based on unknown conditions. Use: "Provisional credit will be calculated and held pending final verification per contract clause."
mira: thanks team. I'll consolidate and route to legal for signoff. If warmup shows p95 <150ms within 48h we'll prepare a reduced final credit; otherwise proceed with provisional credit and comms. Closing loop here.
